```yaml
name: Go Test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: [1.20, 1.21, 1.22]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go ${{ matrix.go-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
          cache: true

      - name: Install test dependencies
        run: go get -u gopkg.in/stretchr/testify.v1/assert

      - name: Run tests
        run: go test -v ./...
```
